name: code-coach
description: A code coach that explains JS/TS code and diagnostics in plain English.

commands.title: Code Coach: Set AI API Key
Code Coach: Clear AI API Key

editor/context.when: editorHasSelection && (editorLangId == javascript || editorLangId == typescript || editorLangId == javascriptreact || editorLangId == typescriptreact)
editorLangId == javascript || editorLangId == typescript || editorLangId == javascriptreact || editorLangId == typescriptreact

codeCoach.ai.enabled.description: Enable AI-assisted explanations (uses your configured endpoint and stored API key).

codeCoach.ai.provider.description: AI provider used for Code Coach requests.

codeCoach.ai.baseUrl.description: Override the base URL for the selected provider. Leave empty to use the default.

codeCoach.ai.endpointPath.description: Override the endpoint path for the selected provider. Supports {model} placeholder.

codeCoach.ai.model.description: Override the model/deployment identifier for the selected provider.

codeCoach.ai.responseStyle.description: Controls how AI explanations are written. 'concise' prefers short bullets; 'detailed' prefers a Copilot-like paragraph explanation.

codeCoach.ai.authHeader.description: Override the authorization header name for the selected provider.

codeCoach.ai.authScheme.description: Override the authorization scheme (e.g., Bearer). Leave empty to send the key as-is.

codeCoach.ai.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens requested from the model.

codeCoach.ai.extraHeaders.description: Extra headers to include in AI requests.

codeCoach.ai.openrouter.referer.description: Optional HTTP-Referer header for OpenRouter requests.

codeCoach.ai.openrouter.title.description: Optional X-Title header for OpenRouter requests.

codeCoach.ai.promptOptimizer.description: Enable the prompt optimizer layer for more consistent LLM outputs.

codeCoach.ai.promptDebug.description: When enabled, print the optimized prompt to the Code Coach output channel.

codeCoach.ai.strictJson.description: Require valid JSON-only responses from the model; otherwise fall back to static explanations.

codeCoach.runtime.enabled.description: Enable runtime capture from debug sessions (captures stack + locals on exceptions).

codeCoach.runtime.autoExplainOnException.description: When the debugger stops on an exception, automatically write an explanation to the Code Coach output channel.

codeCoach.runtime.maxVariables.description: Maximum number of local variables to include in runtime explanations.

codeCoach.ui.explainSelection.description: Where to display Explain Selection results.

codeCoach.ui.explainDiagnostic.description: Where to display Explain Diagnostic command results.

codeCoach.ui.traceDiagnosticOrigin.description: Where to display Trace Diagnostic Origin results.

codeCoach.ui.runtimeException.description: Where to display Explain Last Exception results.

codeCoach.ui.codeSmells.description: Where to display Code Smells reports.

codeCoach.ui.testGaps.description: Where to display Test Gap reports.
